conventions.root: Every ship part and anchor descends from the root; move, rotate or scale the root only.
conventions.anchors: Local +X is the effect axis (exhaust aft; line of fire); +Z as near hull-dorsal as that allows.
conventions.turrets: Rotate the turret pivot (Weapon <slot> pivot) about its local Z to train; the rest pose is the slot angle. Rotate Weapon <slot> elevation about its local Y to elevate; negative lifts the muzzles.
conventions.control: Animate the knobs on the 'Legion control' empty (control.knobs); all 0 is the built pose: deflectors and barriers stowed, doors closed, traversers and cranes parked.
conventions.lamps: Running-light blink is stored on each lamp (blink_period_s, blink_phase_s, blink_duty); the lens materials are shared, so a shot that blinks them keys per-lamp copies.
conventions.metric: Hull units; multiply by metres_per_unit for metres. Nothing in the asset is in metres.
